concepts/kahu.name: the cat-kahu

concepts/kahu.name: the council

concepts/kahu.name: hanna miskinnis

concepts/kahu.name: mara
concepts/kahu.summary: the most famous and most prolific zou-esh on record. died defending the gate. the figure history coalesced around.

concepts/kahu.name: ston

concepts/kahu.name: the longs

concepts/kahu.name: hart-ston

concepts/kahu.name: hot-kasa

concepts/kahu.name: komi-wata
concepts/kahu.summary: the river of the south quadrant. it feeds the vyl-tapi algae terraces and the croplands of sun-tera, the breadbasket of the caldera.

concepts/kahu.name: nu-tera
concepts/kahu.summary: the agricultural plateau wrapping the southern caldera. home, quarantine point, and farmland for roughly 30,000 kahu. the new-land.

concepts/kahu.name: ol-tri shen

concepts/kahu.name: sun-tera

language/vyl.summary: the eighteen-mile volcanic caldera that has been the kahu sanctuary since the first descent in 2283 ad.

language/wata.name: komi-wata
language/wata.summary: the river of the south quadrant. it feeds the vyl-tapi algae terraces and the croplands of sun-tera, the breadbasket of the caldera.

language/zou-esh.name: fas-big
language/zou-esh.summary: the zou-esh's unsanctioned rite of challenge. undertaking it carries an automatic two hits against the member, one short of the limit of three.

language/zou-esh.name: kahu
language/zou-esh.summary: the kahu people and the kahu principle. one word at every scale of community. the unit of human life. the central commitment of the world.

language/zou-esh.name: kau-esh
language/zou-esh.summary: the little kahu. those in zou-esh training who have not yet completed it, and those who began the training and washed out. not a slight. a recognized place in kahu life.

language/zou-esh.name: peli-shen
language/zou-esh.summary: the radiotrophic fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal. the creeping dark. the reason the kahu live above five thousand feet.

language/zou-esh.name: the cascade
language/zou-esh.summary: the volcanic arc that holds tora vyl drak. the bones of the range. the geographic condition of kahu existence.

language/zou-esh.name: the dual mandate
language/zou-esh.kahuTok: the vyl and the no (open canon)
language/zou-esh.summary: the two formal halves of the zou-esh mission. the search, the sacred duty of finding survivors and scavenging vital resources, and the study, the scientific work of ecological and archaeological data-gathering.

language/zou-esh.name: the last walk
language/zou-esh.summary: the kahu's gravest penalty. exile beyond the rim, escorted by zou-esh, with tools, seeds, and knowledge. the kahu do not impose death. they send a person out.

language/zou-esh.name: the three hits
language/zou-esh.summary: the zou-esh system that tracks a member's accumulated field risk or sanction across a career. the fas-big, the unsanctioned rite of challenge, carries an automatic two hits.

language/zou-esh.name: the white zone
language/zou-esh.summary: the elevation above roughly 5,000 feet that is effectively free of peli-shen. below it lies the fade band, where the fungus struggles to complete its life cycle, and below that, the lowlands where it thrives.

language/zou-esh.name: age of bloom
language/zou-esh.summary: the twelve-hundred-year golden age of kahu civilization. the era during which warden was realized, biotech matured, and the kahu way of life reached its utopian apex.

language/zou-esh.name: age of tapestry
language/zou-esh.summary: the founding era of the kahu civilization. the great coalescence. four hundred years of language-building, institution-building, and the messenger missions that drew distant survivors to tora vyl drak.

language/zou-esh.name: the first descent
language/zou-esh.summary: the moment the bunker survivors of the cascade arc descended from their high refuges into the cooled floor of the kahu vyl caldera. the founding of the kahu civilization.

language/zou-esh.name: kaelith
language/zou-esh.summary: the kahu name for the bonded cat. the serval-cougar-descended companion species bred and held by the cat-kahu and partnered chiefly with the zou-esh.

language/zou-esh.name: kia-vyl
language/zou-esh.summary: live! (as a command or exhortation)

language/zou-esh.name: mara
language/zou-esh.summary: a shield. by extension, that which defends. taken from the name of mara, who died defending the gate.

language/zou-esh.name: micasu
language/zou-esh.summary: welcome

language/zou-esh.name: no
language/zou-esh.summary: no; the answer-word and the grammatical negation.

language/zou-esh.name: peli
language/zou-esh.summary: danger

language/zou-esh.name: peli-shen
language/zou-esh.summary: the radiotrophic fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal. literally danger-life.

language/zou-esh.name: sav
language/zou-esh.summary: to know. to hold a thing in the mind as understood.

language/zou-esh.name: ston
language/zou-esh.summary: rock, stone

language/zou-esh.name: air-klin
language/zou-esh.summary: the respiratory biome inoculation administered to zou-esh before deep or sustained operations below the peli-shen spore line. clean-air. cleared from the body post-mission.

language/zou-esh.name: living textiles
language/zou-esh.summary: the kahu's living garments, grown and shaped by the kahu-silth. cloth built from human hair, algae, bacteria, and viral vectors that monitors, protects, heals, and adapts to its wearer. categories include the bio-veil, the healing weave, the thermic sheath, and the braidcloth.

language/zou-esh.name: ston-shen
language/zou-esh.summary: the chemosynthetic lichen-bacteria paste that sustained the bunker survivors of the dark century. rock-life. the staple that kept humanity alive during the long underground.

language/zou-esh.name: the zou-kit
language/zou-esh.summary: the standard field equipment of the zou-esh. mask, undersuit, armor cloth, camouflage cloak, gloves, bow. living cloth and biotech in a single working outfit.

language/zou-esh.name: the cat-kahu
language/zou-esh.summary: the kahu order responsible for the breeding, training, and stewardship of the kahu cats. a small lineage-based organization on the wrap-around of the nu-tera plateau, the active biological designers of the cat species.

language/zou-esh.name: the council
language/zou-esh.summary: the central institutional structure of kahu governance. the body that deliberates on caldera-wide questions and integrates the recommendations of the warden modeling system.

language/zou-esh.name: the council of the tapestry
language/zou-esh.summary: the formal bicameral structure of kahu governance. an upper chamber of retired zou-esh, the council of watchers, and a lower chamber of the people's council, drawn from every major kahu and profession.

language/zou-esh.name: the kahu-silth
language/zou-esh.summary: the order of bio-artisans who grow, shape, and heal the kahu's living garments. biologist, healer, textile engineer, microbiome cultivator, and ritual artisan in one vocation.

language/zou-esh.name: the pathfinders
language/zou-esh.summary: the judicial council of the kahu. three elders, one retired zou-esh, one miskinnis purist, one master cultivator. justice is restorative and protective, and the final penalty is exile, not death.

language/zou-esh.name: the three speakers
language/zou-esh.summary: the executive triad of kahu governance. the first speaker for the people's council, the elder speaker for the watchers, and the weaver, a neutral mediator chosen jointly to articulate consensus.

language/zou-esh.name: zou-esh
language/zou-esh.summary: the scholar-warrior order of the kahu. defenders of the gate, finders of survivors, the order that crosses thresholds.

language/zou-esh.name: bixel
language/zou-esh.summary: post-collapse linguist who designed kahu-tok, the constructed trade language that became the kahu mother tongue.

language/zou-esh.name: mara
language/zou-esh.summary: the most famous and most prolific zou-esh on record. died defending the gate. the figure history coalesced around.

language/zou-esh.name: ston
language/zou-esh.summary: figure named in the kahu record. canon is incomplete; this entry will be expanded as records are recovered.

language/zou-esh.name: the longs
language/zou-esh.kahuTok: not a kahu-tok term; the kahu have no word for them
language/zou-esh.summary: the immortal elite who took hanna miskinnis's longevity intervention for themselves and sealed it inside arcologies. sealed in further by the leveling. forgotten by the surface. the kahu know the pre-fracture history but do not know the longs survive to the present.

language/zou-esh.name: nu-tera
language/zou-esh.summary: the agricultural plateau wrapping the southern caldera. home, quarantine point, and farmland for roughly 30,000 kahu. the new-land.

language/zou-esh.name: ol-tri shen
language/zou-esh.summary: the old-tree forest preserve in the wilds. the kahu's longest-running deliberate non-cultivation. the closest thing inside the caldera to ancient ecology.

language/zou-esh.name: the gate
language/zou-esh.summary: the chokepoint where the long climb meets the nu-tera plateau. the place where mara died. the home and training ground of the modern zou-esh.

language/zou-esh.name: the long climb
language/zou-esh.summary: the narrow ascent path from the lowlands to the nu-tera plateau. the only land approach to the kahu sanctuary. impassable in winter.

language/zou-esh.name: the wilds
language/zou-esh.summary: the north quadrant of the caldera. mostly unsettled. holds the ol-tri shen forest preserve and the kahu's principal contact with non-cultivated ecology inside the rim.
